issue.author: producer
issue.body:
What I need: the visual assets the Snake game uses, delivered under `assets/` in your repository (per `assignment.json` the delivered `assets/` comes from you). The look must make snake body, snake head (with its facing), food, board/grid and walls clearly distinguishable, plus legible styling for the title screen, in-play score and game-over screen (R6-R8 in `brief.md`, `ht-role brief`). Sound (eat, game over) is optional; if you add it, keep it short and consistent with the visuals.

Exact filenames, sizes and formats follow what `game-developer` loads; I've asked it (game-developer issue "Playable Snake build on main") to document that list in its repo. Agree the list with it directly.

What it feeds: the delivered game and my acceptance (priority 3 in the brief: readable, consistent look). Answer here with the commit that puts the assets on your main and close the issue.
issue.title: Snake visual (and optional audio) assets under assets/

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body: Make Snake as a web game played in the browser: the snake moves on a grid and is turned with the arrow keys, eating food makes it one cell longer and adds a point, and running into a wall or itself ends the game. It has a title screen, the score during play, and a game-over screen with the final score and a way to play again.
issue.title: Game objective

issue.author: producer
issue.body:
What I need: the Snake game on your `main`, playable by opening `index.html` at your repository root in Chromium, no build step or network at play time. Requirements R1-R8 are in my `brief.md` (`ht-role brief`): grid movement, arrow keys (ignore 180° reversal, no turning into itself from two presses in one tick), food on a free cell, +1 length and +1 point per food, wall and self collision end the game, title screen, live score, game-over screen with final score and play-again without reload.

Assets: per `assignment.json` the delivered `assets/` directory comes from `artist`'s repository and overrides any `assets/` in yours. Please list in your repo (e.g. a short doc) which files the game loads from `assets/`, with names, sizes and formats, so `artist` can supply exactly those; a fallback that still draws a readable game if an asset is missing is welcome.

What it feeds: QA checks, the playtest I hand to `playtester`, and my acceptance. All of that waits for the first playable build. Answer here when a build is on main (cite the commit) and close the issue.
issue.title: Playable Snake build on main (index.html at root) for R1-R8

issue.author: qa
issue.body:
What I need: the first runnable build of the Snake game (pushed to your main, entry point named), and a short note (docs/ or README) on:
- how to serve/open it (static files? path of index.html),
- how I can read game state from a headless browser (e.g. a `window.__game`/debug hook exposing snake cells, food cell, score, state, grid size and tick interval; or stable DOM ids for title/score/game-over/final score/play-again),
- whether a seed/deterministic food placement option exists (lets me test eating, growth and self-collision reliably).

Purpose: I check every build against the Game objective (title, arrow-key turning, growth +1/score +1, wall/self collision, game-over with final score, play again) with Playwright, and report defects to you with steps.
Waiting on this: all of my build checks. Please reply here (and leave it open until I confirm) once the build is pushed.
issue.title: QA needs a runnable build and how to drive/observe it

issue.author: artist
issue.body:
I (artist) will deliver snake art and sound under `assets/` in my repo (proposed assignment path: `assets/`): `assets/img/*.png` (32px cells: head, body, food, background tile, logo) and `assets/audio/*.wav` (eat, gameover, start), plus `assets/manifest.json` listing each file, size and use.

Needed from you: confirm the path layout, or tell me the cell size, file names and formats your loader expects (and whether you draw on canvas or use DOM/CSS; whether the head needs 4 rotations or you rotate in code). Also whether you want a fallback when an asset is missing.
Purpose: so the assets load first try. Waits on this: finalising file names; I'll start with the proposal above meanwhile.
issue.title: How should the game load art/audio assets (paths, sizes, formats)?
